negative_findings.description: No dedicated procurement/tender section on Oschadbank's own website (oschadbank.ua) could be located. A direct fetch of https://www.oschadbank.ua/tenderi failed with a redirect loop, and repeated Ukrainian-language site-targeted searches returned only third-party aggregators (tender.uub.com.ua, gov.e-tender.ua) rather than a bank-hosted page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only an incidental Prozorro notice referencing an oschadbank.ua contact mailbox was found; no buyer-side terms page confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Oschadbank is the largest state retail bank by branch and ATM footprint; without its own buyer page, buyer-side supplier requirements and historical award terms must be reconstructed entirely from Prozorro records, losing the qualitative detail this cell was meant to capture.

negative_findings.description: No supplier/procurement page was found on Sense Bank's own domains (sensebank.ua / sensebank.com.ua) despite Ukrainian-language searching. Secondary text encountered asserts Sense Bank does not consider itself a 'Замовник' under the public procurement law, yet Sense Bank tenders do appear on Prozorro.
negative_findings.result_summary: Prozorro buyer records exist under EDRPOU 23494714; no bank-hosted procurement page confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ambiguous legal status means an unknown share of Sense Bank's spend may be procured off-Prozorro with no public trace — a structural blind spot rather than a missing document.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching for Ukrainian state-bank equipment procurement (e.g. 'Oschadbank ATM procurement tender award supplier cash recycler Prozorro 2025') returned essentially zero relevant results — the result set was dominated by Indian and UK tender aggregators.
negative_findings.result_summary: English queries are near-useless for this cell; all productive discovery came from Ukrainian-language queries.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that any collection pipeline for UA state-bank procurement must be built on Ukrainian query terms and Ukrainian-language CPV/item descriptions; an English-only monitor would report a false absence of demand.

negative_findings.description: Two buyer-owned pages returned no extractable content on first fetch: ukrgasbank.com/about/tender_committee/ (empty body) and tender.privatbank.ua (empty body after two 302 hops to /commercial/tender).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are treated as bot-defended or JS-rendered hypotheses, not as dead sources; linked documents from both domains are independently indexed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive liveness check would wrongly mark two of the five state-bank buyer portals as dead; they require headless rendering.

negative_findings.description: PrivatBank's former procurement platform zakupivli24.pb.ua appears to have been disabled (secondary reporting indicates mid-2023), with procurement moved to tender.privatbank.ua and Prozorro.
negative_findings.result_summary: Legacy domain should not be used as a live collection target; may still hold archival value if snapshots exist.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical award series for PrivatBank may be split across a retired platform and the current one, breaking longitudinal supplier analysis.

coverage_gaps.description: Oschadbank procures under a head-office EDRPOU plus ~20 regional branch EDRPOUs; only five branch codes were enumerated in this pass (09305480, 09325703, 09331508, 09338500, 09322277).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full Oschadbank branch EDRPOU list from the EDR registry or the aggregator buyer directory, and register every code in the Prozorro API buyer watchlist before any demand-sizing is attempted.

coverage_gaps.description: Buyer-side supplier qualification terms — the thing this cell exists to capture — were only confirmed for PrivatBank, Ukreximbank, Ukrgasbank (documents) and Ukrposhta. Oschadbank and Sense Bank remain undocumented on their own domains.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Attempt headless-browser retrieval of oschadbank.ua and sensebank.ua site maps and search their corporate/'Про банк' sections; if still absent, extract qualification criteria from recent tender documentation attachments on Prozorro instead.

coverage_gaps.description: Only ДП «ДІЯ» (43395033) was confirmed among Diia-adjacent state operators. Other candidate operators in the digital-state and payments-rail perimeter (e.g. Ministry of Digital Transformation itself, state registry/IT operators, and the forthcoming 'Укрпошта Банк' legal entity once licensed) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated Ukrainian-language pass on 'державне підприємство' entities subordinate to Мінцифра and on the Ukrposhta Bank licensing entity, capturing each new EDRPOU as a buyer watchlist item.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code mapping was built for the in-scope hardware/software categories (ATMs, cash recyclers, POS terminals, card personalisation, core banking, cybersecurity). Only one CPV was observed incidentally (39130000-2, office furniture) plus 72250000-2 (systems support services).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Construct an explicit CPV allowlist in Ukrainian (ДК 021:2015) for the target categories and validate it against known past awards at Ukrgasbank/Sense Bank before turning on automated filtering.

coverage_gaps.description: This pass mapped where tenders are announced far better than where awards and executed contracts are published (contract registry, framework-agreement call-offs, amendments).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend to the Prozorro contracting/e-contract endpoints and Ukrposhta's framework-agreement pages, so supplier identity and realised value are captured, not just announced intent.

brief: Procurement by Ukraine's state-owned banks is structurally bifurcated: the legally mandated layer sits on Prozorro (addressable per buyer via ?buyer=<EDRPOU> or, properly, the OpenProcurement API), while each bank also runs its own channel — PrivatBank's tender.privatbank.ua, Ukreximbank's /business/zakupivli/ plus competitive selections buried in its newsroom, Ukrgasbank's tender-committee page with downloadable annual plans and draft contracts, and Ukrposhta's unusually rich hub carrying technical-specification justifications. Oschadbank and Sense Bank are the weak points: neither exposed a buyer-side procurement page in this pass, and Oschadbank additionally fragments its buying across ~20 regional branch EDRPOUs that any head-office-only filter would silently miss. Ukrposhta is the standout demand signal in the cell — a ~17,000-unit bank terminal tender tied to the licensing of Укрпошта Банк — and Ukrainian-language querying is non-negotiable, since equivalent English searches returned nothing usable.
